name: Music Remembered Tee
note:
A white oversized tee with a plain front and handwritten-style black lettering on the back. The music-themed rear graphic adds character without crowding the front. An easy match for jeans and everyday layers.

240 GSM, 100% super-combed cotton. Pre-shrunk and bio-washed, with a Lycra-ribbed neckline and double-stitched construction. Full-length, unisex oversized fit.
